scenes.say: Want faster React apps? Let's see how server components and Next.js make that happen.

scenes.label: Server
scenes.sub: Server components render UI on the backend, cutting client-side JavaScript.
scenes.say: Server components let you render parts of your UI on the backend, so your browser loads less JavaScript.
Next.js gives you server-side rendering, static generation, routing, and API routes—all built in.
Here's a simple Next.js page. It renders on the server, boosting performance and search engine visibility.

scenes.question: Can server components use browser APIs?
scenes.right: No, server components can't access browser APIs or local state.
scenes.say: Don't forget: server components can't use browser APIs or manage local state. That's a common interview gotcha.
